## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D open-world space engineering game.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a browser-based Three.js space flight, asteroid mining, and orbital fabrication game titled VOIDWORKS.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a playable game with a starfield, asteroid belt, orbital forge, ship, flight controls, mining/salvage, upgrade fabrication, HUD, and responsive touch controls.
- Confirmed JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened `http://localhost:3002`; the page loaded and Three.js rendering produced no game-script errors.

### Active
- Browser check is incomplete; no screenshot has been captured or inspected.

### Blocked
- Browser console reports a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), plus WebGL performance warnings.

## Next Move
1. Capture a small JPEG screenshot of the current game and inspect it.
2. Test the launch, flight, mining, and fabrication interactions in-browser; address any issues found.
3. Optionally add a favicon to clear the browser 404.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: contains the complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Changes are uncommitted.
